title: Taker
summary: TA'KER, noun One that takes or receives; one who catches or apprehends. 1. One that subdues and causes to surrender; as the taker of captives or of a city.

inlines.v: TA'KER, noun One that takes or receives; one who catches or apprehends. 1. One that subdues and causes to surrender; as the taker of captives or of a city.
